episode.title: Poker and Life

chapters.title: Amit's Presentation: The Foundations of Poker

episode.tagline: Understanding the foundations of poker can help you understand the foundations of life. How to think about the world -- and how to find peace.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit shares his learnings about the foundational principles of playing poker in a special presentation made for this show. Then Amit and Ajay discuss the life lessons that one can draw from poker.
